mapper.select: SELECT account_id AS accountId, camp_id AS campId, channel_id AS channelId, channel_name AS channelName, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_json, '$.channelCode')) AS channelCode, status AS status FROM channel_account WHERE account_id = #{accountId} LIMIT 1

SELECT raw_id AS rawId, account_id AS accountId, out_order_no AS outOrderNo, pms_order_id AS pmsOrderId, import_status AS importStatus, raw_payload AS rawPayload FROM channel_order_raw WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND out_order_no = #{outOrderNo} LIMIT 1
SELECT pms_order_id FROM channel_order_raw WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND out_order_no = #{outOrderNo} AND import_status = 'success' AND pms_order_id IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM order_main om LEFT JOIN pms_poi p ON p.poi_id = om.poi_id AND p.camp_id = om.camp_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN room_category rc ON rc.room_category_id = om.room_category_id AND rc.camp_id = om.camp_id AND rc.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN room r ON r.room_id = om.room_id AND r.camp_id = om.camp_id AND r.is_deleted = 0

SELECT CAST(om.order_id AS CHAR) AS orderId, COALESCE(om.channel_order_no_snapshot, cor.out_order_no, om.out_order_no) AS outOrderNo, om.order_no AS orderNo, om.status AS status, om.payment_status AS paymentStatus, ca.channel_name AS channelName, om.guest_name AS guestName, om.guest_mobile AS guestMobile, CAST(om.poi_id AS CHAR) AS poiId, COALESCE(p.poi_name, om.poi_name_snapshot) AS poiName, CAST(om.room_category_id AS CHAR) AS roomCategoryId, COALESCE(rc.name, om.room_category_name_snapshot) AS roomCategoryName, CAST(om.room_id AS CHAR) AS roomId, COALESCE(r.room_name, om.room_name_snapshot) AS roomName, DATE_FORMAT(om.start_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS checkInTime, DATE_FORMAT(om.end_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS checkOutTime, om.total_price_cent AS totalPrice, om.total_pay_price_cent AS totalPayPrice, om.commission_price_cent AS commissionPrice, DATE_FORMAT(om.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM order_main om LEFT JOIN channel_account ca ON ca.account_id = om.channel_id AND ca.camp_id = om.camp_id LEFT JOIN channel_order_raw cor ON cor.account_id = om.channel_id AND cor.pms_order_id = om.order_id LEFT JOIN pms_poi p ON p.poi_id = om.poi_id AND p.camp_id = om.camp_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN room_category rc ON rc.room_category_id = om.room_category_id AND rc.camp_id = om.camp_id AND rc.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN room r ON r.room_id = om.room_id AND r.camp_id = om.camp_id AND r.is_deleted = 0
ORDER BY om.created_at DESC, om.order_id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT ca.account_id AS accountId, ca.camp_id AS campId, ca.channel_id AS channelId, ca.channel_name AS channelName, pr.poi_id AS poiId, poi.poi_name AS poiName, rr.room_category_id AS roomCategoryId, rc.name AS roomCategoryName FROM channel_account ca JOIN channel_poi_rel pr ON pr.account_id = ca.account_id AND pr.out_poi_id = #{outPoiId} JOIN channel_room_category_rel rr ON rr.account_id = ca.account_id AND rr.out_room_category_id = #{outRoomCategoryId} JOIN pms_poi poi ON poi.poi_id = pr.poi_id AND poi.camp_id = ca.camp_id AND poi.is_deleted = 0 JOIN room_category rc ON rc.room_category_id = rr.room_category_id AND rc.camp_id = ca.camp_id AND rc.poi_id = pr.poi_id AND rc.status = 1 AND rc.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ca.account_id = #{accountId} AND ca.status = 'authorized' LIMIT 1

SELECT ca.account_id AS accountId, ca.camp_id AS campId, ca.channel_id AS channelId, ca.channel_name AS channelName, pr.poi_id AS poiId, poi.poi_name AS poiName, rr.room_category_id AS roomCategoryId, rc.name AS roomCategoryName FROM channel_account ca JOIN channel_poi_rel pr ON pr.account_id = ca.account_id AND pr.out_poi_id = #{outPoiId} JOIN channel_room_category_rel rr ON rr.account_id = ca.account_id JOIN pms_poi poi ON poi.poi_id = pr.poi_id AND poi.camp_id = ca.camp_id AND poi.is_deleted = 0 JOIN room_category rc ON rc.room_category_id = rr.room_category_id AND rc.camp_id = ca.camp_id AND rc.poi_id = pr.poi_id AND rc.status = 1 AND rc.is_deleted = 0 AND (rc.name = #{roomCategoryName} OR rc.display_name = #{roomCategoryName}) WHERE ca.account_id = #{accountId} AND ca.status = 'authorized' LIMIT 2
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO channel_order_raw ( raw_id, camp_id, account_id, channel_id, channel_code, out_order_no, pms_order_id, import_status, raw_payload, error_message, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{rawId}, #{campId}, #{accountId}, #{channelId}, #{channelCode}, #{outOrderNo}, NULL, 'processing', CAST(#{rawPayloadJson} AS JSON), NULL, NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE channel_code = VALUES(channel_code), raw_payload = VALUES(raw_payload), import_status = 'processing', error_message = NULL, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE channel_order_raw SET pms_order_id = #{pmsOrderId}, import_status = 'success', raw_payload = CAST(#{rawPayloadJson} AS JSON), error_message = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND out_order_no = #{outOrderNo}

UPDATE channel_order_raw SET import_status = 'failed', raw_payload = CAST(#{rawPayloadJson} AS JSON), error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND out_order_no = #{outOrderNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_main ( order_id, camp_id, poi_id, room_category_id, room_id, channel_id, goods_id, order_no, out_order_no, order_type, status, guest_name, guest_mobile, start_at, end_at, day_num, total_price_cent, discount_price_cent, total_pay_price_cent, refund_price_cent, commission_price_cent, payment_fee_cent, platform_service_fee_cent, distribution_commission_cent, settlement_amount_cent, payment_status, payment_type_id, payment_way_id, source_type, poi_name_snapshot, room_category_name_snapshot, room_name_snapshot, stay_type_snapshot, source_label_snapshot, channel_order_no_snapshot, room_snapshot_json, remark, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted, version_no ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{campId}, #{poiId}, #{roomCategoryId}, #{roomId}, #{channelAccountId}, NULL, #{orderNo}, #{internalOutOrderNo}, 'daily_room', 'booked', #{guestName}, #{guestMobile}, #{startAt}, #{endAt}, #{dayNum}, #{totalPriceCent}, 0, #{totalPayPriceCent}, 0, #{commissionPriceCent}, 0, 0, #{commissionPriceCent}, #{totalPayPriceCent}, #{paymentStatus}, 17101, 17206, 'channel', #{poiNameSnapshot}, #{roomCategoryNameSnapshot}, #{roomNameSnapshot}, 'daily_room', #{sourceLabelSnapshot}, #{externalOutOrderNo}, CAST(#{roomSnapshotJson} AS JSON), #{remark}, NOW(), NOW(), #{userId}, #{userId}, 0, 0 )

INSERT INTO distribution_order ( distribution_order_id, camp_id, source_order_id, channel_id, commission_price_cent, settlement_status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{distributionOrderId}, #{campId}, #{orderId}, #{channelAccountId}, #{commissionPriceCent}, 'pending', NOW(), NOW() )
